author_role: one explicitly user-authorized Astra/ultra independent reframe
exposure: All existing local evaluation folds are exposed; fresh agents, changed seeds and repartitioning do not restore a pristine holdout.
allocation_rule: Cards are alternative or conditional successors; their fitting costs must not be summed into an implied allocation.

cards.title: Separate useful correction direction from scale, parent calibration and common A
cards.structural_analogy: Weighted correlation has a local tangent functional; a correction can point usefully while having a damaging finite magnitude, and several apparent improvements can share one direction.
cards.intervention: No deployed intervention: stream fixed F0 parent and five unique corrections; calculate clip-aware right derivatives at alpha0 and alpha0.1, and alpha0 projections onto parent-calibration then parent-calibration-plus-A tangent spans.
assumptions: Exact existing prediction alignment and official weights/mask
Finite nonzero weighted target/prediction variance
Projection is descriptive and never exported as a fitted calibrator
Clipping kinks and numerical rank are handled explicitly
cards.predicted_observable: If shared A is mainly parent calibration, most of its derivative lies in the calibration span; if B/C add distinct useful direction, some positive derivative remains beyond calibration and A.
cards.cheapest_test: DIRECTION_PROBE_RECIPE_R1.md: one bounded streaming pass and per-component moment recombination; optional separately qualified F1 A.
cards.falsifier: Substantial useful A or B/C direction survives the corresponding nuisance span, weakening the calibration-only/shared-only explanation; opposite signs across cells weaken portability. Neither finding alone identifies the training cause.

rough_cost.measurement_status: Proposed cap; actual implementation/profile not run by this author

cards.reusable_artifact: Source-qualified per-component cross moments, tangent/rank report, fixed endpoint check and execution receipt

cards.title: Test mean-only state against the missing zero-stat readout
cards.structural_analogy: A feature treatment needs a trained control with the same output correction machinery; an untouched parent cannot separate added function capacity from new information.
cards.intervention: Z zeroes all208 appended relationship slots while retaining211 raw/event inputs; A uses the actual lag1 mean-only state. Both use419-to64-to2 architecture and matched seeds, source order, optimizer and fixed checkpoint.
assumptions: Existing F0/F1 parents and cache ancestry remain source-clean for evaluated groups
New seed2201/F0 and2202/F1 identities are unused and frozen before fitting
Identical strictFP32 recipe and fixed additional0.1 serving correction
Equal parameter count does not imply equal active feature geometry
In-sample fit residual mismatch is intentionally held constant
cards.predicted_observable: If evolving input means/errors supply useful information, fixed-shrink A improves over fixed-shrink Z across the two cells; if generic readout dominates, Z recovers most of A's value.
cards.cheapest_test: Four total new heads: Z and A on each of two matched parent cells; both targets, each paired delta and equal-cell mean; base and raw corrections are secondary comparisons.
cards.falsifier: A does not reliably add a practically useful direction beyond Z under this regime; this weakens this mean-state recipe, not all online adaptation. If both fail versus parent, investigate shared residual fitting before expanding the state.

rough_cost.wall_estimate: Unknown until bounded source-cache/fitter throughput measurement; include setup, export and grade; no production-reserve spending implied

cards.reusable_artifact: Missing-control predictions, exact paired source/config/ancestry manifests and official complete endpoint grades
cards.prior_art_and_novelty: Related to generic-control H-ASTRA23-07-A and the current CONTROL_INTERPRETATION_R1 note. This is a concrete unexecuted control, not a new model family.
cards.owner_handoff: Root creates/adapts the prospective draft; a named actor owns all four fits through export; independent grader owns comparison.

cards.title: Audit what numerical equality measures before calling it information age
cards.structural_analogy: The observation process and the observed value can carry different information; repeated anonymous numbers can reflect encoding atoms or quantization rather than elapsed physical time.
cards.intervention: First target-free audit: for fixed fitting-only sequences retain per-field atom counts, nonzero-increment/ULP scale, boundary/saturation patterns and full-row group-change disagreement. Only then define a causal value-plus-update-pattern representation preserving raw inputs.
assumptions: No physical timestamp or missingness mask is inferred merely from equality
Source-qualified whole-sequence state resets
No whole-test counts or future observations
Event flags already in the baseline are explicitly matched
cards.predicted_observable: If equality mostly reflects encoding, age differences concentrate around recurring atoms/resolution regimes; if it reflects distinct update processes, reproducible field-specific event relationships persist beyond common activity and numerical atoms.
cards.cheapest_test: Reuse declared96-sequence sample or a predeclared fitting-only equivalent for a streamed target-free diagnostic; freeze outputs before any target-conditioned interpretation.
cards.falsifier: No stable atom/resolution or conditional update structure beyond existing event features; deprioritize this encoding descendant rather than add another blanket clock panel.

rough_cost.rough_wall: Expected small sampled scan, but measured reader memory/profile required; no run admitted

cards.reusable_artifact: Source-qualified encoding/clock contract and causal incremental-statistics specification

cards.title: Measure the effective training distribution before replacing WMSE
cards.structural_analogy: Averages of normalized local losses need not optimize the same measure as one globally pooled weighted loss; correct population weighting and practical optimization are different questions.
cards.intervention: No first-pass model change: reconstruct the exact frozen8192-row fitting batches and row-weight producer contract; measure each target's mass, mass ratio and variation in inverse batch denominator. Compare with pooled weighting without choosing a replacement using evaluation labels.
assumptions: Correct clipped-label weight remains unchanged
Diagnostic uses fitting data and source-bound row weights
Ordered batching, final tail and target-sharing are represented exactly
Population WMSE/correlation equivalence is not mistaken for optimizer equivalence
cards.predicted_observable: If batch mass is consequential, large/structured inverse-mass variation reweights sequence/target regimes beyond the declared pooled objective; if masses are nearly constant, this explanation loses practical priority.
cards.cheapest_test: One streaming fitting-cache mass audit, zero model fits; preserve additive per-batch/group diagnostics.
cards.falsifier: Denominator variation is too small or unstructured to explain a material optimization change; a later matched normalization test can reject the specific proposed repair even when the measures differ algebraically.

rough_cost.rough_cost: One fitting-cache scan; charge actual IO and memory; do not infer sub15minutes from evaluation-cache timings

cards.reusable_artifact: Effective-loss-measure receipt linked to exact batch and mask/row-weight semantics
cards.prior_art_and_novelty: H-ASTRA23-04-A already proposes chunk-mass normalization; reuse that lineage. The new contribution is tying it to the recovered online-head fitter, not inventing a new loss.
cards.owner_handoff: Actor audits producer/consumer semantics; independent critic verifies the estimand before any changed-loss fits.

cards.title: Separate data diversity from optimizer exposure in the fidelity reversal
cards.structural_analogy: A proxy is an intervention on the learning process, not a noisy copy of the final experiment; equal epochs on different data fractions change several mechanisms.
cards.intervention: Recover per-run public/private metadata where authorized: full sequence support, unique components, optimizer updates and LR progress. Proposed follow-up holds update count and schedule in update units fixed while comparing the nested data supports, with innovation and moment controls at each support.
assumptions: Actual reported shortscreen preserves full20k sequences
No unavailable private grade is treated as inspected
Both arms share exposure schedule within a support
Onefold/seed four-fit diagnostic cannot establish crossfold generality
cards.predicted_observable: If extra optimization absorbs the innovation advantage, matching update exposure should alter the p10/p25 contrast; if broader data reduces its value independently, the contrast persists at matched exposure.
cards.cheapest_test: Metadata audit first, zero fits; inspect individual paired deltas rather than the near-zero p25 mean alone. A later4fit2arms-by2supports single-cell screen is a mechanistic diagnostic, not full-budget confirmation.
cards.falsifier: The same directional fidelity contrast persists under matched exposure and equal history support, weakening optimizer-progress attribution; or the original contrast fails to reproduce, exposing cell/selection variation.

cards.title: Test the diagonal cross-instrument correspondence assumption
cards.structural_analogy: An anonymous shared index is not necessarily a physical matching relation. A restricted diagonal estimator tests a specific matching prior, not all causal cross-instrument relationships.
cards.intervention: Source audit the52paired-channel estimator. On fitting-only matured input pairs, compare diagonal covariance concentration with a predeclared blockwise low-rank matching statistic, retaining the same causal lag/maturity. Any learned map is fitted only on allowed groups and frozen before evaluation.
assumptions: No book-depth ordering or instrument correspondence is invented
Raw differences remain valid causal features but are not called physical returns
Unrestricted dense-head fixed permutations are not used as a false information-removal control
Low-rank map costs and ancestry are counted as fitting if deployed
cards.predicted_observable: If diagonal matching discards important relation structure, stable off-diagonal covariance and a restricted low-rank state can add value beyond the diagonal state at matched readout capacity.
cards.cheapest_test: Zero-new-neural-fit source/covariance audit on fixed fitting sequences. Predictive follow-up is conditional and requires separately accounted learned-map cost.
cards.falsifier: Diagonal/block structure captures essentially all stable useful relation signal, or a matched low-rank descendant fails to improve the complete endpoint; neither invalidates generic online relationships.

cards.reusable_artifact: Explicit correspondence assumption and fitting-only cross-moment receipt

cards.owner_handoff: Actor first establishes a concrete missing relation; no arbitrary architecture launch from source suspicion alone.

cards.title: Measure conditional component value at the actual served endpoint
cards.structural_analogy: A component that no longer improves the best single predictor can still contribute complementary error information to an ensemble, but only the actual complete comparison measures that value.
cards.intervention: Freeze complete reference and replacement mixtures, coefficients and clipping order; evaluate exact callbacks/predictions on identical source-qualified rows and measure replacement contribution, not the candidate's standalone rank.
assumptions: Permitted team assets and explicit ancestry
Native numerical/export differences are measured
H390 fitted/unknownTL3 ancestry diagnostics remain labeled as such
No public coefficient selection
Ordinary seed diversity is an opportunity-cost comparator only when exact clean cells exist
cards.predicted_observable: A weaker standalone member helps only if its disagreement aligns with the reference endpoint's remaining weighted target error after actual clipping; shared redundant members do not automatically improve a mixture.
cards.cheapest_test: Reuse exact frozen native replay outputs once root's admitted technical gate passes; no new model fits. Keep diagnostic and clean-CV evidence separate.
cards.falsifier: The component's conditional contribution vanishes or reverses at the actual served reference, or numerical/ancestry constraints prevent the intended comparison. This rejects the specific replacement, not the source model family.
